user_message: Moutai Q2 wholesale data was weak again. I keep hearing 'channel migration' — but isn't that just end demand weakness?
assistant_message: Not necessarily. Channel migration (e.g. distributor -> direct -> DTC) changes *where* revenue is recognised, but if end consumption is unchanged the gap should close. The reusable principle: separate channel inventory movement from end-demand weakness. End-demand weakness shows up as falling scan data and rising channel destocking. Channel migration alone shows up as accounting reclassification without end-demand deterioration. Failure conditions: (1) distributors may absorb inventory to mask weakness, so the signal lags 2-3 quarters. (2) Reclassification can be one-way; once moved, distributors rarely get restocked.
